setup.title: R1: адреса шлюза LAN1 и LAN2 на портах по MAC
setup.run:
# R1 is the gateway of LAN1 and LAN2, but the lab constructor configures only IOL gateways (gateway_not_configured):
# this step sets the addresses. R1 has no built-in setup, so this is its first command: wait for the ports.
:local t 0
:while ([:len [/interface ethernet find]] < 2 && $t < 90) do={:delay 1s; :set t ($t + 1)}
# Adapter N is the N-th ethernet port by ascending MAC (as the manager does it), not etherN.
:local macs ({})
:foreach i in=[/interface ethernet find] do={:set ($macs->[/interface ethernet get $i mac-address]) $i}
:local ids ({})
:foreach m,i in=$macs do={:set ids ($ids, $i)}
:if ([:len $ids] < 2) do={:log error "gns3lab-setup r1-ports: 2 ethernet ports expected"; :error "ports"}
:local lan1 [/interface ethernet get [:pick $ids 0] name]
:local lan2 [/interface ethernet get [:pick $ids 1] name]
/interface ethernet set [find name=$lan1] comment="LAN1 (PC1)"
/interface ethernet set [find name=$lan2] comment="LAN2 (SRV1)"
# The default configuration of CHR asks DHCP on ether1.
/ip dhcp-client remove [find interface=$lan1]
/ip dhcp-client remove [find interface=$lan2]
# Repeatable: what this step or someone else set before goes first.
/ip address remove [find comment="gns3lab-setup"]
/ip address remove [find address="192.168.10.1/24"]
/ip address remove [find address="192.168.20.1/24"]
/ip address add address=192.168.10.1/24 interface=$lan1 comment="gns3lab-setup"
/ip address add address=192.168.20.1/24 interface=$lan2 comment="gns3lab-setup"

setup.title: R1: имя, loopback lo0, DNS srv1.lab, пользователь auditor
setup.run:
/system identity set name="R1-SETUP"
:if ([:len [/interface bridge find name="lo0"]] = 0) do={/interface bridge add name="lo0" protocol-mode=none comment="gns3lab-setup"}
/ip address remove [find address="10.255.255.1/32"]
/ip address add address=10.255.255.1/32 interface="lo0" comment="gns3lab-setup-lo"
/ip dns static remove [find name="srv1.lab"]
/ip dns static add name="srv1.lab" address=192.168.20.10 comment="gns3lab-setup"
:if ([:len [/user find name="auditor"]] = 0) do={/user add name="auditor" group=read password="Audit-2026" comment="gns3lab-setup"} else={/user set [find name="auditor"] group=read}

setup.title: R1: выключить telnet/ftp/www/api, фильтр input
setup.run:
/ip service set [find name="telnet"] disabled=yes
/ip service set [find name="ftp"] disabled=yes
/ip service set [find name="www"] disabled=yes
/ip service set [find name="api"] disabled=yes
/ip firewall filter remove [find where comment~"^gns3lab-setup"]
/ip firewall filter add chain=input connection-state=established,related action=accept comment="gns3lab-setup: established"
/ip firewall filter add chain=input protocol=icmp action=accept comment="gns3lab-setup: icmp"
/ip firewall filter add chain=input protocol=tcp dst-port=22 src-address=192.168.20.0/24 action=accept comment="gns3lab-setup: ssh from LAN2"
/ip firewall filter add chain=input protocol=tcp dst-port=22 action=drop comment="gns3lab-setup: ssh from elsewhere"

setup.title: PC1: имена srv1.lab и r1.lab в /etc/hosts
setup.run:
set -e
# cloud-init may rebuild /etc/hosts from its template at boot: the names go to both.
for f in /etc/hosts /etc/cloud/templates/hosts.debian.tmpl; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  grep -q '[[:space:]]srv1\.lab$' "$f" || printf '192.168.20.10\tsrv1.lab\n' >> "$f"
  grep -q '[[:space:]]r1\.lab$' "$f" || printf '10.255.255.1\tr1.lab\n' >> "$f"
done

setup.title: SRV1: пользователь netops и файл /srv/lab/README
setup.run:
set -e
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
id -u netops >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -s /bin/bash netops
echo 'netops:Netops-2026' | chpasswd
mkdir -p /srv/lab
printf '%s\n' 'gns3lab setup ok: SRV1' > /srv/lab/README
